is_anopheles.evidence: Page 5: 'For the bioassays, we used pyrethroid-resistant laboratory An. coluzzii VKPER colony.'

reports_target_markers.evidence: Page 5 mentions that the VKPER colony was selected repeatedly to maintain the kdr west gene, but no target resistance markers were genotyped in this study.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype counts, allele counts, or allele frequencies are reported in the text, tables, or figures.

african_field_population.evidence: The bioassays were conducted exclusively using the laboratory colony Anopheles coluzzii VKPER. No field-collected mosquitoes were genotyped or tested in bioassays.

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical study examining the synergistic effect of Metarhizium pingshaense and deltamethrin on mosquito mortality.

sub_country_location.evidence: Page 5 mentions Valley du Kou, Soumousso, and Bana in Burkina Faso regarding the origin of the colony and fungal isolates.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No collection window <=3 years is reported for field mosquito sampling or genotyping.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy of combining native Metarhizium pingshaense fungal strains with deltamethrin against the pyrethroid-resistant laboratory colony Anopheles coluzzii VKPER. No field mosquito populations were genotyped, and no extractable marker genotype data were reported.
exclusion_reasons: Does not genotype any target insecticide resistance markers.
Does not report extractable genotype data.
Only tests a laboratory colony (VKPER); no African field population mosquitoes were genotyped.
